title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AGRI - WeatherStation
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/WeatherStation. A sensor or system that measures weather conditions. Dual subclass of ssn:System and saref:Sensor (W3C SSN / SAREF core, not modeled here); as a ssn:System it can itself compose sub-sensors (ssn:hasSubSystem), and as a saref:Sensor it can directly report observations. Inherited vocabulary from both parent classes is documented here rather than repeated structurally, per the Gaia-X inheritance-flattening precedent. Convenience numeric attributes are exposed for the weather-related s4agri:Property named individuals a weather station typically aggregates (ETSI TS 103 410-6 clause 4.2.6): s4agri:AirTemperature, s4agri:AmbientHumidity and s4agri:Precipitation.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'WeatherStation'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

location.description: GeoProperty. The physical location of the weather station.

hasSubSystem.description: Relationship. ssn:hasSubSystem (inverse: ssn:deployedOnPlatform/hasSubSystem context). The sub-sensors (e.g. a Pluviometer, a Thermometer) composing this weather station.

airTemperature.description: Property. Last value observed for the s4agri:AirTemperature named individual ('the degree or intensity of heat present in the air'), in degrees Celsius. IRI: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/AirTemperature.

ambientHumidity.description: Property. Last value observed for the s4agri:AmbientHumidity named individual ('the amount of water vapour in the air'), in percent relative humidity. IRI: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/AmbientHumidity.

precipitation.description: Property. Last value observed for the s4agri:Precipitation named individual ('the amount of water falling in the soil by natural process, e.g. rain'), in millimetres. IRI: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/Precipitation.

dateObserved.description: Property. The date and time these measurements were made.
